policy.boundary_policy: Only reviewer-estimated visible start/end candidates are executable. Source prediction, force, gaze, 3D racket release and exact contact remain unverified. Never extend a short source stage to satisfy sampling gates.
policy.selection_policy: All twelve previously listed MIT actions were inspected before computing new stage-card outputs; unresolved candidates remain in this inventory.
policy.frame_review_origin: OpenCV sequential decode; displayed index bound to pre-existing actual FFmpeg PTS ledger; production replay independently decodes original video again.

effective.start: 持拍手开始主动加速，球拍进入释放准备状态
effective.end: 球拍轨迹与预测击球轨迹开始收敛

start_boundary.visual_observation_zh: 持拍手与高位准备姿态分离后，手臂向低位来球区域连续移动，球拍随后下降展开；加速起点是视觉估计，不是肌力或数值加速度真值。

end_boundary.visual_observation_zh: 活动球与球拍在画面左前低位区域明显接近，随后球方向改变并离开；这里只标二维接近候选，未恢复原文所述预测击球轨迹，也未确认真实接触。

effective.start: 持拍腕单手持续加速，非持拍手与球拍分离
effective.end: 球拍与活动球进入身前接触候选区

start_boundary.visual_observation_zh: 持拍手开始独立向身前运动，非持拍手已解除球拍辅助并向后展开；不把持续加速度当直接物理观测。

end_boundary.visual_observation_zh: 活动球与球拍在身体前方的同一区域接近；相邻后帧显示球向外离开。仅作可见接近候选，不认定精确触球时刻。
